guideRepairs.walk-00-v3: Create ONE transparent full-body Lumine game-animation source frame. Image 1 is the APPROVED identity, costume, anatomy ratio, style, sword and camera reference. Image 2 is a POSE GUIDE ONLY: its red segment is the leg attached to the viewer-LEFT hip beneath the sword arm; its blue segment is the leg attached to viewer-RIGHT hip. Render both as normal white/gold Lumine boots/skin, NO colored bones, no guide marks. Follow image 2 leg overlap and joint positions LITERALLY. This is an opposite-step pose needed to alternate with our other frames. Keep image 1 head size, face, head/body proportion, torso, hands, flower, outfit and sword. Do not re-use image 1 leg pose. Full sword and feet must be inside canvas with margin. 1024x1536 portrait. 3/4 side view facing right, calm natural forward walk. No chibi, no background, no ground shadow, no glow, no text. Hair top around y107, hip y890, ground y1435. Contact step: red/NEAR thigh crosses IN FRONT from left hip diagonally to knee on RIGHT and forward foot on RIGHT; blue/FAR thigh goes behind it diagonally down-left to back foot. Clearly draw the X overlap of thighs. Near boot heel contacts right side, far boot toe pushes behind on left. Do not draw the left hip leg extending left.
